bio.text: Bubba Underwood (listed by Ballotpedia as Kerry Underwood, also known as Bubba), a Republican, has represented District 3 in the Alabama House of Representatives since taking office on November 9, 2022, and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.
Underwood was born in Sheffield, earned a bachelor's degree from the University of North Alabama in 1990, and has worked as a CPA, including owning Underwood & Associates CPA.
He served as mayor of Tuscumbia.
